dsh-custom-ui is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Right-side file-tree sidebar that opens workspace files, plus a DeepSeek account balance meter in the composer stats line.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-db2c174205acb5adb8af.html
